information: Identical interleaved real calibration bank, exact registered remaining input sizes and own completed observations only. No post-run control timing enters a decision.
controls: Fixed commits the complete finite budget-DP stationary suffix plan once. Feedback-greedy uses the same bank and its own completed observations, starts with each module's cheapest already admitted image, and spends the one shared credit only on the largest positive current-epoch saving after complete setup cost; it does not inspect suffix costs. DP recomputes the finite remaining-trace allocation at each epoch. NDU evaluates the identical supplied suffix assignments with the original native framework. All arms receive the same eligible information, proof/image reuse and one shared candidate-build credit.
prospective_revision: A separate feedback-greedy arm and four cyclic Latin groups were added on 2026-10-30 before collecting any performance-study samples. The earlier correctness/native-text preflight is not cost qualification and did not change the workload, guard, call count, budget or sample policy.
opportunities: After all policies, each module executes separate fresh-session base, guarded and guarded-narrowed full-trace controls. Their preparation, delivered work and cleanup are included. Finite paired wall differences do not establish statistical superiority.
cost_scope: Current source admission, driver build and text extraction, real calibration, native preparation/proofs/builds/sealing, lease/identity/output checks, evidence writes, controller requests and shutdown. Common setup is charged once per standalone arm. Unallocated dispatch and final identity-check costs are conservatively charged to NDU. Actual empty-target native build is separately added to its cold total.
excluded_costs: post-run opportunity controls and analysis from strategy totals, retained in total study time
final aggregate encoding and archive creation
acceptance: All outputs/budgets/releases and source/tool identities must pass, and both modules must have actual distinct guarded-narrowed native text. NDU must have lower complete attributed cost than fixed, feedback-greedy and DP for an observed net-cost pass. No statistical, universal, global-optimality or machine-code-refinement claim.
